description:
Move the repository-state store's oversized inline test module into a sibling file and rename tests that are named after review rounds to the scenario-describing convention.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store.rs` carries 1,805 lines of production code followed by a ~3,900-line inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` (starting at line 1806) holding 66 tests. The module must move to a sibling test file so the production file carries only production code. The relocated module stays a `#[cfg(test)]` unit-test module compiled into the `jit` library (for example via a `#[path]`-declared or child-module sibling file), not a new integration-test crate: `@/inv/bounded-rust-build-footprint` constrains integration-test *target count*, not file count, so the split must add zero integration-test targets.

Seven tests in that module are named after review rounds rather than the behavior under test, which is meaningless without the review transcript and violates the `test_<function>_<scenario>` convention:

- `test_finding2_worktree_companion_is_worktree_colocated_and_cleaned` (line 4022)
- `test_finding2_rollback_restores_worktree_action_from_companion_backup` (line 4090)
- `test_finding2_companion_creation_failure_recovers_clean` (line 4138)
- `test_finding2_orphan_companion_is_swept_on_open` (line 4180)
- `test_f2_committed_recovery_tolerates_edited_worktree_target` (line 4350)
- `test_a1_rolledback_recovery_tolerates_edited_worktree_target` (line 4624)
- `test_a5_prepared_delete_recovery_restores_original` (line 4737)

Each must be renamed to `test_<function>_<scenario>` describing the function and scenario it exercises; the existing scenario suffixes already indicate the behavior and can seed the new names.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` is relocated out of `storage/repository_state_store.rs` into a sibling test file compiled as the same unit-test module, and the production file retains only production code.
- [hard] REQ-02: The relocated module remains a `#[cfg(test)]` unit-test module of the `jit` library and adds no integration-test target, keeping the Rust build footprint within its enforced budgets.
- [hard] REQ-03: No test name in the module retains a `test_finding2_`, `test_f2_`, `test_a1_`, or `test_a5_` review-round prefix; each such test is renamed to a `test_<function>_<scenario>` name describing the behavior under test.
- [hard] REQ-04: The full store test suite compiles and passes after the move and renames, with the same set of tests as before (none dropped or skipped).
title: Split the store test module to a sibling file and fix review-round test names
